display_long_description:
Step into a whole new dimension of puzzle gaming with this immersive VR experience designed for VR devices. This is not just another puzzle game—it's a skill-based, physics-inspired challenge where precision, timing, and strategy matter.

🧩 Unique Gameplay

Control a rotating wrench with a simple tap mechanic. Snap from point to point, navigate complex paths, and overcome dynamic obstacles. Every level introduces new challenges that test your reflexes and planning.

🎮 100+ Challenging Levels

Enjoy a progressively difficult journey with over 100 handcrafted levels. Each stage is designed to keep you engaged, from relaxing puzzles to intense brain-teasing scenarios.

⚡ Obstacles & Strategy

Avoid traps, time your rotations perfectly, and find the smartest path to reach your destination. One wrong move can reset your progress—precision is key.

💰 Rewards & Progression

Earn coins as you complete levels and improve your performance. Unlock new stages and advance through increasingly complex challenges.

🎢 Bonus VR Experience – Amusement Park Rides

As you progress, unlock exciting VR amusement park rides. Sit back, relax, and enjoy immersive experiences that reward your achievements in the game.

🕶️ Built for VR

Designed specifically for VR, this game delivers smooth, immersive gameplay with intuitive controls and engaging environments.

🚀 Key Features:
Unlockable VR amusement park rides
One-tap intuitive controls
Logical Power
